hero.headline: I craft compelling motion stories for modern brands
hero.subtext: Creating bold motion visuals that combine creativity with modern technology. Focused on SaaS motion design, advanced animation systems, and AI workflows.

motion.title: Hitech Trade Show Reel
motion.summary: Vertical recap of a Hitech Insurance trade-show booth, mixing footage of the stand, trucks and branded merchandise with animated text overlays.

motion.title: ElevenLabs Sound Effects UI
motion.summary: Dark, glowing product animation of an AI sound-effects library: a UI panel reveals, then kinetic callouts for sample rate, duration and looping lead into an animated waveform.

motion.title: Blackbox AI x NVIDIA Launch
motion.summary: Monochrome tech launch film with grid layouts, a tokens-per-second counter, glitch typography and an 'End-to-End Encrypted' card, closing on a Blackbox AI x NVIDIA lockup.

motion.title: Brandstorm Creative Reel
motion.summary: Vertical kinetic-typography reel on a purple gradient with hand-drawn accents, icons and a handshake photo, ending on a 'Connect with us' call to action.

motion.title: Claude Product Film
motion.summary: Product film where a single line branches into tasks, a chat asks 'Where should we start?', code gets fixed in an editor, notes spread into a map and a meadow scene reads 'Time to think'.

motion.title: ChatGPT Assistant Promo
motion.summary: Clean white-and-blue UI animation that cycles through use cases, types into an 'Ask anything' box and shows ChatGPT answering a prompt, ending on 'Meet ChatGPT'.

motion.title: ClickUp AI Workflow
motion.summary: Colourful UI motion piece with animated cursors, team member cards, a step-by-step 'Updating' screen and AI-generated task cards, closing on 'You bring the idea'.

motion.title: Prefr Loan App Walkthrough
motion.summary: Vertical walkthrough of the Prefr loan sign-up on a Lxme co-branded page: entering a phone number, applying online and filling in the OTP screen, ending on the Prefr logo.

motion.title: FYNITE AI Agents Explainer
motion.summary: Dark, neon-green 3D UI explainer covering data connections, noise filtering, agent pods, 'Deploy in Days' and 'ROI in weeks', ending on the FYNITE logo and URL.

motion.title: GenPage Outreach Explainer
motion.summary: Bright purple-and-blue explainer that opens on spam counts and a falling reply-rate chart, then shows personalized landing pages, a lead table and prospect cards.

motion.title: Hitech Insurance Kinetic Ad
motion.summary: Soft peach-and-orange kinetic typography ad with blurred word reveals and bubble transitions, ending on the Hitech Insurance logo.

motion.title: Lumen Atlas Commerce Explainer
motion.summary: Minimal beige UI explainer about cart abandonment: a stat card, a free-shipping rule panel, a campaign prompt and the line 'On brand. On budget. On time.'

motion.title: Claude x Higgsfield MCP
motion.summary: Playful promo with cartoon blob characters and an After Effects panel showing Higgsfield MCP connected to Claude, followed by blue-sky captions and a 'Comment AE' call to action.

motion.title: Hitech Cargo Insurance Reel
motion.summary: Vertical motion-graphics reel asking 'Your truck is insured. What about theft?', using photo cut-outs and bold type to lead into motor-truck cargo insurance and the Hitech logo.

motion.title: Motion Monck Studio Intro
motion.summary: Bold Swiss-style brand intro with blueprint line art, red-and-cream shapes, a numbered 'launch' card and 'next up: your idea', closing on 'you dream, we do.'

motion.title: Morandi Furniture Typography
motion.summary: Vertical poster-style animation pairing large Chinese characters with cut-out chairs, tables and sofas on red, cream and grey backgrounds.

motion.title: MacBook Neo Motion Spot
motion.summary: Short white-background product spot: a green laptop spins in with 'hello NEO', coloured lids are arranged by hand, Japanese typography flies past and it ends on 'Switch to Apple'.

motion.title: Nova Finance App Explainer
motion.summary: Fintech explainer that types a spending question into a chat bar, then shows budget cards, 'Just the numbers that matter' and floating investment and growth widgets before the logo.

motion.title: RazorSense AI Brand Film
motion.summary: Airy blue-and-white piece mixing floating interface cards, a 'ChatGenius' chat screen, fluid abstract textures and a piano close-up, resolving to the RazorSense logo.

motion.title: Think Filmy Instagram Promo
motion.summary: Short promo that types '@think_filmy' into a search bar and flips through animated Instagram profile cards on white and dark tiled backgrounds.

motion.title: Glass UI Interactions
motion.summary: UI micro-interaction study: a 'Start your design journey now' button, glowing rings revealing a glass card, and a tilted stack of frosted service-name fields.

motion.title: Follow What's Interesting
motion.summary: Vertical reel that moves from a typed chat to an Instagram post, then draws a blue route across a map to 'Follow what's interesting', ending on a glowing 'Follow Think Filmy' slider.

motion.title: Hitech Website Launch
motion.summary: Website launch video for Hitech Insurance showing the 'Say Hi to Insurance' homepage, an auto-insurance quote form, policy tracking and a security section, with orange hand-icon accents.

motion.title: Notion Logo Animation
motion.summary: Minimal black-and-white logo build: a page icon expands into a grid of block-type icons, then collapses into the Notion 'N' and wordmark.

motion.title: Radic Launch Video
motion.summary: Launch video for an AI ad-creative tool: product ad cards, a brand dashboard, an 'Add Brand Kit / Fetch brand data' step and a ThinkBox diagram linking audience, competitor and ad-library sources.

editing.title: Luxury House Property Tour
editing.summary: Real-estate tour of a modern house that opens on an aerial view of the roof and pool, then moves through the kitchen, open living room, bedroom and bathroom with smooth gimbal shots.

editing.title: Spotify Radar x Red Bull Aftermovie
editing.summary: Vertical event aftermovie with fast cuts and text cards ('Day 2'), stunt-rider and dirt-track shots, crowd moments and a trophy celebration.

editing.title: Varanasi Travel Film
editing.summary: Cinematic travel film of Varanasi: dawn aerials over the Ganges, crowded golden-hour streets, a boat ride, evening aarti and a portrait by the river.

editing.title: Kitchen Cooking Film
editing.summary: Letterboxed food film from a working kitchen: onions being chopped, meat and greens cooking in heavy smoke, and a cook at the stove, graded in warm amber tones.

editing.title: Tea Product Commercial
editing.summary: Studio product spot for loose-leaf tea: leaves pouring from the jar, a lemon being sliced and squeezed, slow-motion particles and a final tea-and-lemon hero shot.

editing.title: Lamborghini Urus Drift
editing.summary: Vertical car edit of a Lamborghini Urus: drive-mode close-ups, road tracking shots and drone shots of the SUV drifting on a red dirt track.

editing.title: Superbike VFX Edit
editing.summary: Night-time superbike reel with flash transitions, a glowing outline VFX with floating gold wheels, and close-ups of the RS badge and exhaust flame.

editing.title: Kshm Brand Film: Curiosity
editing.summary: Street-fashion brand film following a man in a leather jacket and teal trousers through old city lanes, doorways and a parking lot, ending on the green Kshm logo.

editing.title: Geetanjali Salon Walkthrough
editing.summary: POV-style vertical walkthrough of a Kérastase salon with text overlays ('Where the vibe says Relax', 'the mirror says Wow') across wash stations, product shelves and styling chairs.

editing.title: REMAX Royal Apartment Tour
editing.summary: Apartment walkthrough covering the living room, dining area, pendant lights, bathroom and vanity, finishing on a city-skyline aerial.

editing.title: Steak Plating Cinematic
editing.summary: Short vertical food edit: steak on the grill, greens and potatoes tossed in a pan, and gloved hands plating the dish with sauce on a dark marble counter.

editing.title: Thulsi Restaurant Review
editing.summary: Vertical restaurant review at Thulsi, a pure-vegetarian multi-cuisine restaurant, with a host tasting soup, starters and mains to camera, with subtitles.

editing.title: Ford Mustang Red Cinematic
editing.summary: Golden-hour car edit of a red, white-striped Ford Mustang kicking up dust on a dirt road, with tree-lined compositions and a red Audi R8 cameo.

editing.title: Kawasaki Ninja Lightning VFX
editing.summary: Kawasaki Ninja reel shot at night and on the highway, with motion-blur wheel effects and an orange smoke-burst VFX around the parked bike.

editing.title: Mountain Snow Road Ride
editing.summary: Vertical road-trip edit in the hills: an off-road jeep in the forest at golden hour, motorcycles on a snowy mountain road and riders taking in the view.

editing.title: Hayabusa Model Shoot BTS
editing.summary: Behind-the-scenes reel of a photo shoot with a rider in a leather jacket and pink-visor helmet posing on a Suzuki Hayabusa.

editing.title: Bike Week Motocross Event
editing.summary: Vertical event recap with motocross racing on a dirt track, an arm-wrestling contest, a Motoverse 2023 photo card and a night concert with pyrotechnics.

editing.title: Holi Festival Cinematic
editing.summary: Warm red-and-orange festival edit of Holi celebrations with colour-covered faces, dancers and rooftop silhouettes.

editing.title: B&W Documentary Reel
editing.summary: Black-and-white letterboxed reel of everyday city life: a wristwatch close-up, hands at work, a cyclist passing a car and a crowded railway platform.

editing.title: Chest Day Short Film
editing.summary: Letterboxed gym short film that starts outside an Anytime Fitness at night and follows a lifter through his workout in moody, low-key light.

editing.title: Kshm Brand Film: Happy
editing.summary: Upbeat Kshm fashion film with a man in a beret and leather jacket on busy market streets, neon shop signs and a ukulele moment, ending on the Kshm logo.

editing.title: Kshm Brand Film: Vintage
editing.summary: Vintage-graded Kshm fashion film with an old green motorbike, a graffiti shutter, a ukulele player beside band drums and a relaxed pose on a car.

editing.title: Fashion Photoshoot BTS
editing.summary: Vertical behind-the-scenes edit of an ethnic-wear shoot, cutting between models in lime, red floral, pink and green outfits in styled interiors.

editing.title: Raasa Wedding Festivities
editing.summary: Wedding film that opens on VHS-style footage, then cuts between guest interviews, a dancing haldi ceremony and colourful aerial shots of a decorated poolside party.

editing.title: Carlton Hotel Franchise Presenter
editing.summary: Vertical presenter-led ad for Carlton spa franchising: a host speaks to camera about occupancy, wellness demand and revenue sharing, with bold captions.

editing.title: Adhira Appa Coffee Franchise
editing.summary: Presenter-led franchise ad for Adhira Appa Coffee: a host talks to camera about owning a café, with captioned highlights and product-pack shots.

editing.title: How To Film Gym Tutorial
editing.summary: Educational gym reel that labels each shot type on screen ('Rising Action – Close Up', 'Climax – Establishing Shot', 'Falling Action – Creative Shot') while a lifter trains.

ai.title: AI Insurance Spokesperson Ad
ai.summary: AI-generated insurance commercial with a hospital-corridor opener, then two presenters in front of Hitech Insurance branding with kinetic captions such as 'In one moment' and 'Should be simple'.

ai.title: AI Trucking Insurance Film
ai.summary: AI-generated, subtitled explainer for trucking insurance with scenes of an agent on the phone, truckers beside their rigs, a semi on the open road and a closing handshake.

services.title: Motion Graphics
services.description: Creating dynamic visual animations that combine movement, typography, graphics, and storytelling to communicate ideas in a visually engaging way. This includes SaaS animations, explainer visuals, promotional content, kinetic typography, UI animations, and branded motion systems designed for modern digital experiences.

services.title: Video Editing
services.description: Crafting cinematic and engaging video content through professional editing techniques such as pacing, storytelling, seamless transitions, speed remapping, multi-layer compositions, and visual synchronization. Focused on delivering polished edits that enhance emotion, retention, and visual impact.

services.title: AI Filmmaking
services.description: Using AI-powered tools and workflows to enhance video production, automate creative processes, generate visuals, improve editing efficiency, and create next-generation cinematic experiences. Combining human creativity with AI technology for faster and more innovative content creation.

services.title: Sound Design
services.description: Designing immersive audio experiences through cinematic sound effects, ambient layers, transitions, dialogue enhancement, audio mixing, and emotional sound storytelling. Focused on creating sound environments that elevate the overall visual experience.

services.title: Brand Films
services.description: Producing visually compelling brand stories that combine cinematic visuals, motion graphics, sound design, and storytelling to communicate a brand’s identity, values, and message in a powerful and engaging way.

services.title: UI Motion Design
services.description: Designing smooth and interactive interface animations that improve user experience, enhance usability, and create visually appealing digital interactions. Includes micro-interactions, transitions, loading animations, onboarding sequences, and product interface motion systems.

services.title: Creative Direction
services.description: Developing the overall visual and storytelling direction for projects by combining strategy, aesthetics, motion, branding, and communication design. Focused on creating cohesive creative concepts that align with brand identity and audience engagement.

services.title: Color Grading
services.description: Enhancing the visual mood and cinematic quality of footage through professional color correction and grading techniques. Includes tone balancing, contrast control, cinematic looks, film emulation, and creating consistent visual aesthetics across projects.

services.title: Interactive Experiences
services.description: Creating immersive and motion-driven digital experiences that encourage engagement and interaction through dynamic animations, responsive visuals, transitions, and interactive storytelling elements for modern web and digital platforms.

services.title: 3D Motion Design
services.description: Designing cinematic 3D visuals, animated environments, product animations, simulations, and motion sequences that add depth, realism, and high-end visual quality to digital content and brand experiences.

services.title: Visual Identity
services.description: Building cohesive visual systems that define a brand’s appearance through typography, color palettes, logo presentation, layout systems, design consistency, and modern visual communication principles to create a strong and recognizable brand presence.

about.name: UPANANDA
about.title: MOTION DESIGNER & VIDEO EDITOR
bio: I'm a Motion Designer and Video Editor specializing in high-end visual storytelling, advanced motion graphics, and cinematic editing. I create visually engaging content that blends creativity with strategy to help brands stand out.

My expertise includes SaaS motion design, AI filmmaking, AI-powered video editing and generation, UI motion design, and interactive motion experiences. I also have strong knowledge of sound design, branding, color grading, typography, and visual design principles.

With a deep understanding of consistent brand identity and brand color systems, I focus on creating polished, modern, and impactful visuals that not only look professional but also communicate clearly and effectively.
